tabpanel.name: Compute
tabpanel.paragraph: Build and deploy serverless functions and full-stack apps on Cloudflare's global network. No servers to manage. No cold starts or region complexity.

div.heading: Build with your favorite AI agent

div.heading: What's new
div.paragraph: The latest features and improvements shipping across Cloudflare.

div.heading: Control authorization cookies for multi-domain Access applications
div.paragraph: Access administrators can control whether self-hosted applications preemptively set authorization cookies across their public hostnames.
Preview: @cloudflare/computer agent runtime
An agent runtime that dynamically orchestrates between isolates and containers, giving every agent a virtual filesystem and execution environment.
Python and JavaScript Workers can now call each other via RPC
Workers RPC now supports cross-language calls between Python and JavaScript Workers without additional dependencies or schema definitions.
Cloudflare One Client for Windows (version 2026.7.1210.1)
Cloudflare One Client for Windows (version 2026.7.1210.1)
Cloudflare One Client for macOS (version 2026.7.1210.1)
Cloudflare One Client for macOS (version 2026.7.1210.1)
Static OAuth client credentials for MCP server portals
Connect MCP servers that require a pre-registered OAuth client to an MCP server portal.
Browser Run adds a Playground to the Cloudflare dashboard
Run screenshots, PDFs, data extraction, and AI extraction against a live browser from the dashboard, then copy the generated code.
Rotate Stream broadcast keys for live inputs
Rotate credentials for a Stream live input without changing the live input ID or its other configuration.

region.heading: Security that scales
region.paragraph: Everything you need to secure applications, APIs, and infrastructure.

div.paragraph: PUBLIC WEBSITES & APPS

link.paragraph: Protect your applications without sacrificing performance
Identify and block malicious payloads before they can compromise your application.
Encrypt your site in minutes
Streamline TLS Certificate Management.
Verify visitors without CAPTCHA
Confirm web visitors are real and block unwanted bots without slowing down web experiences for real users.

div.paragraph: CORPORATE AND HOME NETWORKS

link.paragraph: Securely connect origins with post-quantum encrypted tunnels
Outbound-only encrypted tunnels, no open ports.
Secure internal applications with Cloudflare Access
Identity-first, quantum-safe access to private applications and infrastructure.
Secure Internet browsing without disruptions
Cloud-native Secure Web Gateway (SWG) that inspects browser traffic without disruption.

div.heading: Faster web performance
div.paragraph: Accelerate websites and applications with Cloudflare CDN caching, image optimization, smart routing, load balancing, and web analytics.

link.paragraph: Fast, reliable and resilient DNS queries
World's fastest authoritative DNS, consistently ranked #1 by DNSPerf; free, fully API-managed, DNSSEC supported.
Minimize origin load and accelerate dynamic content
Intelligently manage traffic, optimize content delivery, and safeguard origin infrastructure.
Default caching for static assets, with cache rules for full control
Caches content in 330+ cities worldwide, with instant purging and granular Cache Rules.
Assess your site speed and apply recommended optimizations
Application delivery optimizations including minification, Brotli compression, Early Hints, and HTTP/3.
Transform, optimize, and deliver images worldwide
Cloudflare Images handles format conversion, responsive sizing, and intelligent caching.
Understand the performance of your web pages
Cloudflare Web Analytics collects Core Web Vitals and performance data from 100% of page views without cookies or sampling.
